LanguageData.CC_Making_Chain_Record: Use is what the colony ate, wore out and used up over the last {0} days. A bench's making is what it made in that time where it has a record, else its bills at its hand's speed there.
LanguageData.CC_Making_Chain_RecordSoon: Use and making are estimated until the colony's record of what it uses covers a day: everyone's meals, the sick's medicine, and each bench's bills at its hand's speed there.
LanguageData.CC_Making_Chain_RecordOff: Use and making are estimated (everyone's meals, the sick's medicine, each bench's bills at its hand's speed there): a record of what the colony uses needs the deeper game hooks switched on.
LanguageData.CC_Making_Chain_FromUse: Use from the colony's record, making estimated.
LanguageData.CC_Making_Chain_Hand: {HAND} would work it, about {HOURS} hours a day.
LanguageData.CC_Making_Chain_HandSeen: {HAND} has worked it lately, about {HOURS} hours a day.
LanguageData.CC_Making_Chain_BenchDown: The bench can't be worked now: it has no power or is broken down.
LanguageData.CC_Rearr_AisleTip: How wide the council keeps the ways through the room.
LanguageData.CC_Rearr_Aisle_Needed_Tip: Two cells wide where the room is busy (more than one door, or six pieces or more), one cell elsewhere.
LanguageData.CC_Rearr_Aisle_One_Tip: Ways one cell wide are fine: the furniture may stand closer together, and people squeeze past each other.
LanguageData.CC_Rearr_Aisle_Two_Tip: The ways are kept two cells wide wherever the room allows, so nobody waits to get past.
LanguageData.CC_Rearr_KeepTip: How much better a new place has to be before a piece is moved. Heavy pieces and full shelves always take a clearer gain than light ones.
LanguageData.CC_Rearr_Keep_Light_Tip: Furniture moves for a small gain: the room comes out much as the rules would lay it, with more moves.
LanguageData.CC_Rearr_Keep_Usual_Tip: Furniture moves when the new place is better by more than the work of moving it.
LanguageData.CC_Rearr_Keep_Firm_Tip: Furniture moves only for a clear gain: a room that works stays much as it is.
